# P2P signalling put and split BF16 cells

The pinned P2P benchmark exercises two separate paths. With root 55 the receiver gets the bytes. With root 56 the sender puts the bytes and sets a different remote signal for each CTA. The host allocates symmetric BF16 payload buffers and int64 signal words. The public benchmark supplies nonuniform BF16 values and checks the receiver's tensor against its reference. Sources inspected 2026-11-26 at Triton-distributed `7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a`. [Allocation](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/layers/nvidia/p2p.py#L61-L70) · [Input and configuration](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/test/nvidia/test_pp.py#L231-L260) · [Census roots 55–57](../census/MinimalSyntax.md#triton-distributed-kernels)

| Root | Recorded scope |
| --- | --- |
| 55, `p2p_copy_kernel` (historical 96) | #296 covers launches in which each CTA's byte count is a multiple of the element size. A split BF16 cell is a diagnosed gap in #596. The default eight-CTA launch satisfies the premise. [User decision](https://github.com/VeriInfra-Lab/VeriTile-2/issues/296#issuecomment-7197417954) · [Read-path inventory and controls](https://github.com/VeriInfra-Lab/VeriTile-2/pull/612) |

The public seven-CTA launch fails the typed range checks. This is a third live root requiring a cross-width payload relation for the split launch. The user owns the disposition under the #596 trigger. [Trigger](https://github.com/VeriInfra-Lab/VeriTile-2/issues/296#issuecomment-7197417954) |
| 57, `p2p_copy_remote_to_local_kernel` (historical 98) | The fused BF16/byte loads and stores are a diagnosed gap in #596, outside #296. [User decision](https://github.com/VeriInfra-Lab/VeriTile-2/issues/593#issuecomment-7174675011) |

## Root 56 sites

`CommOp.write(..., fused=False)` copies the local typed tensor to the source buffer and launches `p2p_put_kernel[(sm,)]` with the source and destination, the original byte count and an int64 signal array. One invocation of `putmem_signal_nbi_block` per CTA sends its range to the other rank. Its SET goes to `signal_ptr + pid`. The receiver waits for the signals, retrieves the typed buffer, and the test synchronizes and compares it with the reference. The signal addition is on an unchanged int64 pointer and falls outside the cast-pointer site count. [Public write](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/layers/nvidia/p2p.py#L118-L135) · [Caller](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/test/nvidia/test_pp.py#L101-L113) · [Wait and buffer read](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/test/nvidia/test_pp.py#L147-L168) · [Checked put path](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/test/nvidia/test_pp.py#L298-L315)

| [P2P:108](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/kernels/nvidia/p2p.py#L108) | add | int8 destination pointer → int8 pointer | `data_copy_begin` bytes | Remote BF16 range on aligned, whole-cell partitions. An odd start or count fails. |
| [P2P:109](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/kernels/nvidia/p2p.py#L109) | add | int8 source pointer → int8 pointer | `data_copy_begin` bytes | Local BF16 range under the same partition. The destination range is checked first. |

The kernel partitions 100,663,296 bytes (8192 × 6144 BF16 values) in ceiling-sized chunks. With eight CTAs, the last copies 6,291,456 BF16 cells starting at cell 44,040,192 and sets remote signal 7. With seven CTAs, the first sends 14,380,471 bytes. CTA 1 begins at byte 14,380,471. The two transfers meet inside BF16 cell 7,190,235. The public adapter reports `pointer view: byte count is not divisible by the buffer unit` for CTA 0 and `pointer view: transfer start is not cell aligned` for CTA 1. This path requires relating a partially written destination cell to the two independently signalled transfers. The receiver's final wait does not supply that relation at either transfer's completion. [Kernel partition and call](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/kernels/nvidia/p2p.py#L97-L115) · [Public SM-count option](https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Triton-distributed/blob/7908e4ea9010bb2238f9f05b28c904fd4b71c60a/python/triton_dist/test/nvidia/test_pp.py#L38-L47)

The gated client passes the two casts and the complete signalling call to `with_pointer_views`. It specializes the partition arithmetic outside the quotation and checks ranges, rank, NBI mode, signed signal word, value and operation. A second control sends one BF16 in two separately signalled one-byte chunks. Both chunks are rejected for BF16 storage and accepted for byte storage at the expected source, destination and signal addresses. These are frontend checks. The GPU harness supplies source evidence only. [Lean client](../../tests/lean/dist/P2PPutViews.lean)

With `TD` pointing to a checkout containing the pin, run `python3 scripts/census/check_p2p_put_inventory.py "$TD"`. The check compares the kernel blob with the pin, counts the two casts and two additions against the table, and compares the two cast statements and complete signalling call with the public Lean client's source. [Source check](../../scripts/census/check_p2p_put_inventory.py)
